get_model_by_name: get a pretrained Demucs source separation model by name from the remote model repository
get_model_from_local_repo: get a pretrained Demucs model from a local repository directory by model signature
get_model_htdemucs_default: get the default htdemucs Hybrid Transformer Demucs model for music source separation
get_model_unittest: get a unit test Demucs model with 4 channels for drums, bass, other, and vocals
list_dependencies: list the python package dependencies required for Demucs including torch, torchaudio, and tqdm
